# Build Heritage

> Build Heritage is a licensed and insured residential and commercial home services company in Georgia, USA, serving Metro Atlanta and communities statewide. Every quote is free, written and itemized line by line, with no obligation.

Contact: info@buildheritage.org · Free quote: https://buildheritage.org/#contact

## Services
- [Packing & Moving](https://buildheritage.org/services/packing-moving.html): Careful hands. Zero drama. Your things arrive like they left.
- [Painting](https://buildheritage.org/services/painting.html): Crisp lines, flawless finish — interior and exterior painting done right.
- [Drywall](https://buildheritage.org/services/drywall.html): Walls so smooth you'll forget they were ever damaged.
- [Flooring & Vinyl](https://buildheritage.org/services/flooring.html): Luxury vinyl, laminate and more — floors built for real life.
- [Framing](https://buildheritage.org/services/framing.html): Straight, square, and built to code — the bones your project deserves.
- [Doors](https://buildheritage.org/services/doors.html): Entry, interior, patio — doors that close like they mean it.
- [Window & Door Trim](https://buildheritage.org/services/window-door-trim.html): The details that make a house look finished — and expensive.
- [Roofing & Tiles](https://buildheritage.org/services/roofing.html): Storm-tested roofs and tile work that protects what matters.

## Typical Georgia prices (2026 cost guide)
Ranges quoted across metro Atlanta; exact price depends on size, condition and materials. Full guide: https://buildheritage.org/cost-guide.html
- Painting — Single room, interior: $350–$900
- Painting — Whole-home interior repaint: $3,000–$8,000
- Painting — Exterior repaint: $2,500–$7,500
- Painting — Kitchen cabinet refinishing: $1,800–$4,500
- Roofing & Tiles — Full roof replacement: $9,000–$20,000
- Roofing & Tiles — Roof leak repair: $400–$1,800
- Roofing & Tiles — Storm/hail damage repair: $800–$6,000
- Roofing & Tiles — Gutter replacement: $1,000–$2,800
- Flooring & Vinyl — Luxury vinyl plank (LVP), installed: $4–$8 per sq ft
- Flooring & Vinyl — Laminate, installed: $4–$7 per sq ft
- Flooring & Vinyl — Subfloor repair/leveling: $2–$6 per sq ft
- Flooring & Vinyl — Old floor removal & disposal: $1–$2 per sq ft
- Drywall — Small hole/patch repair: $150–$450
- Drywall — Room hang + finish: $1,000–$2,800
- Drywall — Popcorn ceiling removal: $1–$2 per sq ft
- Drywall — Water-damage rebuild: $500–$2,500
- Packing & Moving — Local move, 2BR apartment: $600–$1,500
- Packing & Moving — Local move, 4BR home: $1,500–$3,500
- Packing & Moving — Full-service packing add-on: $400–$1,200
- Packing & Moving — Office/commercial move: $1,200–$6,000
- Doors — Entry door replacement, installed: $1,200–$3,500
- Doors — Interior door, installed: $250–$600 per door
- Doors — French/patio door: $1,800–$4,800
- Doors — Smart lock install: $150–$400
- Window & Door Trim — Window casing, per window: $100–$250 per window
- Window & Door Trim — Baseboards, installed: $6–$12 per linear ft
- Window & Door Trim — Crown moulding: $8–$16 per linear ft
- Window & Door Trim — Exterior PVC trim repair: $300–$1,200
- Framing — Basement framing: $7–$16 per sq ft
- Framing — Load-bearing wall removal: $3,000–$10,000
- Framing — Rot/termite framing repair: $800–$5,000
- Framing — Deck framing: $15–$30 per sq ft
